structured_output.summary: The change follows the spec for Array.prototype.flatMap. It calls ToObject, then LengthOfArrayLike, then the IsCallable check, then ArraySpeciesCreate(O, 0), then FlattenIntoArray with depth 1, the mapper and thisArg, then returns the array. Every fallible call is propagated with `?`. It reuses the existing flatten_into_array helper, as the ticket says. It contains no special-casing, defaults or swallowed errors, and it touches only the in-scope file. The gate report shows 45 of 47 target runs passing with no regressions. The 2 failures are proxy-access-count.js (sloppy and strict), which fail with the not-implemented error for Proxy.
